segment.source: Renders the figures that make up a cost of ownership over time — licence, hosting, staff hours, migration, downtime — each as a number with its unit and a line saying what it is measured against. Use it for: a three-year cost argument against an incumbent, build-versus-buy pages, a switching business case, a tender annex. Prefer 'Feature Comparison Matrix' when the comparison is about capability rather than money, and 'Bundle Panel' for a saving inside a single offer.
